summary: A panel that slides in from any edge and closes by swipe, with a title, description and body. Wrap the app in `DrawerIndent` so the page steps back while one is open, which needs the `indented` state.

props.name: trigger
props.description: The trigger button's label. An element, such as a list row, is the trigger itself and keeps its own look. Leave it out when `open` opens it from code.

props.name: render
props.description: Your own element as the trigger, such as a link, an avatar or a picture, in place of the default one. It takes the trigger's behavior and none of its look; the focus outline and `className` merge onto its classes. An element that cannot take focus, like an ``, needs `tabIndex={0}`.

props.name: triggerIcon
props.description: A glyph beside the trigger's label.

props.name: triggerIconPosition
props.description: Which end of the trigger `triggerIcon` sits at.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state, for opening it from code: a menu item, a keyboard shortcut or a list row. Uncontrolled (the default) if omitted.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called whenever it opens or closes, controlled or not.

props.name: snapPoints
props.description: Heights a `bottom` or `top` drawer rests at, as a fraction of the screen or a length.

props.name: defaultSnapPoint
props.description: The snap point it opens at. The first one when omitted.

props.name: snapPoint
props.description: Controlled snap point, with `onSnapPointChange`.

props.name: onSnapPointChange
props.description: Called whenever it moves to another snap point.

props.name: modal
props.description: `true` locks the page while it is open; `false` leaves the page usable; `trap-focus` keeps focus inside but leaves the page scrolling.

props.name: swipeToOpen
props.description: A strip along its edge, marked with a grab bar, that opens it with a swipe.

props.name: title
props.description: The drawer's heading, wired up by Base UI's own Drawer.Title.

props.name: description
props.example: Markdown, 4 KB. Edited today and kept in Documents.
props.description: The body text, wired up by Base UI's own Drawer.Description.

props.name: children
props.description: The body, below the description. Style it yourself. A Drawer placed here opens on top of this one; a `bottom` or `top` drawer then steps back behind it, which needs the `nested` state.

props.name: closeLabel
props.description: A full-width button at the end that closes the drawer. None renders without it.

props.name: side
props.description: The edge it slides in from, and the direction a swipe closes it.

props.name: handle
props.description: A grab bar on the edge facing the page, for a `bottom` or `top` drawer.

props.name: showClose
props.description: An X in the corner. A swipe, a click outside and Esc close it either way.

props.name: variant
props.description: `edge` sits against the side it slides from; `flyout` floats 12px clear of every edge.

props.name: size
props.description: Padding and text size of the trigger and the close button, on the same scale as Button.

props.name: shape
props.description: Corner radius on the edge that faces the page, and on the buttons. Inherits the nearest `Shape`.

props.name: animated
props.description: The slide in and out and the backdrop's fade. A swipe follows the finger either way.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes. `merge` folds them in last, so one here replaces the component's own class for the same utility.

props.name: focus
props.description: The focus outline. `true` draws it, `false` removes it, and a string of Yumma CSS utilities restyles it on every focusable part of the component, which is more than `className` reaches. Removing it outright and putting nothing back fails WCAG 2.4.7.

props.name: container
props.description: Where the drawer is rendered. Defaults to `document.body`; pass an element to portal somewhere else, such as inside a frame.

props.title: budget.xlsx
props.description: Spreadsheet, kept in Documents / Taxes.

props.title: Versions
props.description: 12 saved versions. The newest is from today, 10:42.

usage.title: Nesting
usage.text: A Drawer placed in another's `children` opens on top of it. A `bottom` or `top` drawer steps back behind the new one, which needs the `nested` state.

usage.title: DrawerIndent
usage.text: Wrap the app in `DrawerIndent` so the page steps back while a drawer is open. It needs the `indented` state.
